Maria (Partnerships): Quick channel check 1 - marketplace listing + partner co-announce for Nimbus. Need to finalize embargo window, partner quote matrix, landing hero(s), SI one-pager, and a handoff checklist for the partner success teams.
AJ (Growth): Ill take the outreach plan and target list. Can someone confirm the priority partner list?
Maria (Partnerships): Priority: Partner X (cloud), Partner Y (SI), Partner Z (hardware). Partner X needs co-marketing quote, Partner Y needs joint webinar slot, Partner Z requests logo review and compliance check.
Olivia (Marketing): Got it. Ill draft two headline options and a short subhead (one enterprise-focused, one dev/PLG-focused). Ill also queue hero comps with design. ETA: Thurs 10:00 PT.
Samir (Product): Draft tech blurb for the marketplace tile: "Redwood Nimbus: unified private inference with deterministic latencies, cost-aware routing, and workload-aware batching." Short bullets for hero next.
Kai (Eng): Staging landing deployed at https://staging.marketplace.redwood.dev/nimbus - note: requires SSO. CDN cert in progress. Ill upload the build artifacts and a screenshot to /shared/marketing/assets.
Lina (Legal): Please add Partner Zs logo usage agreement to /legal/partner-logos. We need a signed LOA before public use. Typical turn time ~48 hrs.
AJ (Growth): Press embargo target proposal: Tue Jul 2 14:00 UTC. Partner pre-announce at Tue Jul 2 12:00 UTC for tier-1 partners. Does that timeline work?
Maria (Partnerships): Works if legal + assets in by Mon EOD. Proposed checklist:
```
- Mon Jul 1 EOD: final partner quotes + logos in /press-assets
- Tue Jul 2 02:00 UTC: staging smoke test + CDN validation
- Tue Jul 2 12:00 UTC: partner pre-announce (select list)
- Tue Jul 2 14:00 UTC: embargo lift / public announcement
- Wed Jul 3: SI enablement doc + webinar invite sent
```
Olivia (Marketing): Question: do we want separate landing variants per partner? That adds time but looks nicer. Maybe a generic hero plus partner callouts.
Samir (Product): Generic hero + partner callouts is the fastest. Ill prepare 3 callout bullets we can swap per partner.
Kai (Eng): FYI partner-specific code snippets (marketplace deploy example) need a short review from security. Ill open a PR and tag @Lina.
Lina (Legal): Noted. Also need to review press quotes for trademark mentions. Please avoid partner trademark expansions without approval.
AJ (Growth): Ill draft outreach angles: cloud performance, enterprise reliability, and carrier-grade hardware integration. Will post the media spreadsheet here.
LaunchBot: Reminder scheduled for 2765432160 (Tue Jul 2 12:00 UTC) to trigger partner pre-announce pings.
Maria (Partnerships): Action owners summary: Olivia (headline + hero + assets), Samir (blurb + callouts), Kai (logos + staging + snippets), Lina (logo/legal signoff), AJ (press list + outreach). Report blockers by Mon 16:00 PT. :rocket:
